subject: english
stem: This talk happens while both speakers have time to make a change. Which detail is given in the conversation?
options: the paint boxes must reach the bookstore before five twenty
the book cartons must reach the bookstore before ten o'clock
the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty
the book cartons must reach the science room before five twenty

optionRationales.reason: the paint boxes must reach the bookstore before five twenty：此項把「book cartons」改成「paint boxes」。對話明確陳述「the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty」。

the book cartons must reach the bookstore before ten o'clock：此項把「five twenty」改成「ten o'clock」。對話明確陳述「the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty」。
the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。對話明確陳述「the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty」。

the book cartons must reach the science room before five twenty：此項把「bookstore」改成「science room」。對話明確陳述「the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the book cartons must reach the bookstore before five twenty」。
